Sam (AE): Need an ephemeral hosted API key for Velos exec demo tomorrow 10:00 PT. Requirements: inference-only, IP lock to their office, TTL 6h, rotation possible mid-demo, auditable revoke. Lina?
Lina (Solutions Engineer): I can create under org velo-42. Confirm IPs and no embeddings/uploads.
Sam (AE): IPs: 3.90.22.100/32 and 3.90.22.101/32. Confirmed: generation only.
Lina (Solutions Engineer): Creating via internal API. Snippet:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://admin.internal.redwood/v1/keys \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"org_id":"velo-42","name":"velos-exec-ephemeral","scopes":["inference:generate"],"allowed_ips":["3.90.22.100/32","3.90.22.101/32"],"ttl_hours":6,"no_console_preview":true,"tags":["poc:velos_demo"]}' | jq .
```
Secret will be vaulted, not pasted here. Revoke command for SRE/PS team:
```bash
curl -X POST https://admin.internal.redwood/v1/keys/REPLACE_KEY_ID/revoke -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
```
Mark (SRE): I scheduled auto-revoke at T+7h as safety and enabled audit logging. If they need mid-demo rotation: Sales pings SE->SRE, SE creates replacement key and SRE revokes old after verification. Please request rotation in-thread with justification.
Lina (Solutions Engineer): Key created: key_id=kr_07LmN9. Secret stored in vault: https://vault.company/velos/kr_07LmN9 (access: sales@redwood,se@redwood). no_console_preview=true set.
vault-bot: vault_record created key_id=kr_07LmN9 vault_url=https://vault.company/velos/kr_07LmN9
Sam (AE): Thanks! I'll share vault link with Velos ops and confirm in-thread when demo ends.
Mark (SRE): Confirm once revoked and I'll close the auto-revoke job if done early.
Lina (Solutions Engineer): Revoked at 2405120185 via API: key_id=kr_07LmN9 revoked_by=lina_se reason=demo_end. Vault item removed.
vault-bot: audit_log action=revoke key_id=kr_07LmN9 revoked_at=2405120185 revoked_by=lina_se
